Senses.Explanation: Indra is the named celestial ruler whom the records invoke in inherited assemblies, contests, offerings, and vivid teaching-seat comparisons. Masters bring Indra into the hall by putting his nose within reach of a pointing finger, naming his fear at a raised implement, or retelling his exchanges with the Buddha.
